content.text:
I’ve pulled the top available properties in Tokyo for 1 adult, Sept 1–4, 2025, at roughly US $100–200 per night. All prices are per-night averages in USD and include free cancellation where available:

1. Hotel Mystays Asakusa-bashi  
   • Location: Near Asakusabashi Station (JR Sobu Line)  
   • Rating: 8.1/10 (4 star)  
   • Avg. rate: US $108 per night (US $324 total)  
   • Link: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/mystays-asakusa-bashi.html  

2. Tokyu Stay Ginza  
   • Location: Ginza (Chuo‐ku), steps from Yurakucho Station  
   • Rating: 8.4/10 (4 star)  
   • Avg. rate: US $122 per night (US $366 total)  
   • Link: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/tokyu-stay-ginza.html  

3. Shinjuku Prince Hotel  
   • Location: West Shinjuku, above Seibu–Shinjuku Station  
   • Rating: 8.2/10 (4 star)  
   • Avg. rate: US $137 per night (US $411 total)  
   • Link: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/shinjuku-prince.html  

4. Hotel Gracery Shinjuku  
   • Location: Kabukicho (Shinjuku), next to Godzilla head  
   • Rating: 8.3/10 (4 star)  
   • Avg. rate: US $150 per night (US $450 total)  
   • Link: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/gracery-shinjuku.html  

5. APA Hotel Shinjuku-Gyoemmae  
   • Location: 2 min walk from Shinjuku-Gyoenmae Station (Marunouchi Line)  
   • Rating: 8.4/10 (3 star)  
   • Avg. rate: US $168 per night (US $504 total)  
   • Link: https://www.booking.com/hotel/jp/apa-shinjuku-gyoemmae.html  

Let me know if any of these look good, or if you’d like to see more options or adjust filters!
